name: Gusseted Corner Bracket
description: 60 x 60 mm right-angle corner bracket, 40 mm wide, with a triangular gusset rib and two M5 clearance holes per leg.

steps.instruction: Create the horizontal leg: a plate 60 mm long (X, from X=0 to X=60), 40 mm wide (Y, centered) and 5 mm thick (Z), base on Z=0.

transcript.user_prompt: Create the horizontal leg: a plate 60 mm long (X, from X=0 to X=60), 40 mm wide (Y, centered) and 5 mm thick (Z), base on Z=0.

steps.instruction: Add the vertical leg: a plate 5 mm thick (X, from X=0 to X=5), 40 mm wide (Y, centered) and 60 mm tall (Z, from Z=0 to Z=60), fused with the horizontal leg at the corner.

transcript.user_prompt: Add the vertical leg: a plate 5 mm thick (X, from X=0 to X=5), 40 mm wide (Y, centered) and 60 mm tall (Z, from Z=0 to Z=60), fused with the horizontal leg at the corner.

steps.instruction: Add a triangular gusset rib between the legs: a right triangle with vertices at (X, Z) = (5, 5), (30, 5) and (5, 30) in the XZ plane, extruded to 6 mm thick and centered on Y=0.

transcript.user_prompt: Add a triangular gusset rib between the legs: a right triangle with vertices at (X, Z) = (5, 5), (30, 5) and (5, 30) in the XZ plane, extruded to 6 mm thick and centered on Y=0.

steps.instruction: Drill two M5 clearance holes of radius 2.75 mm through each leg on the Y=0 centreline: through the horizontal leg at X=35 and X=50, and through the vertical leg at Z=35 and Z=50.

steps.instruction: Chamfer the straight top edges of the vertical leg (at Z=60) with a 1 mm chamfer.
